QuestInfo.name: [Boss Battle] Magnus
QuestInfo.0:
Magnus, the scourge of the Nova, has taken over the capitol city of Grandis, Heliseum.
Enter the Tyrant's Castle and defeat Magnus to reclaim the city for its rightful people. 

- #eParticipation Requirements#n
   1) Easy Mode: Lv. 90 and up
   2) Normal Mode: Lv. 100 and up
   3) Chaos Mode: Lv. 100 and up

- #eParty Size#n: 1+
- #eRoute#n 
   1) Easy Mode: Portal at the Heliseum Reclamation HQ
   2) Chaos Mode: Entrance to the top floor of Tyrant's Castle
